body: Yeah, it's supposed to deduplicate them. I'll update the docs.

Thanks @nik9000, question, should it be a feature request to have `values` not dedup (possibly via an parameter)? There are some use-cases I've hit where it'd be valuable to have _all_ values returned.
I'd use the `TOP` function in that case. There you have to manually limit how many to return, but that helps it not grow uncontrollably.
